explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/647 ([Er79d]): for every k there are infinitely many n with max_{n−k<m<n}(m + τ(m)) ≤ n + 2. The statement takes the supremum over m ∈ Ioo (n−k) n in ℕ. Truncated n − k matters only for the finitely many n < k. For k ≤ 1 the range is empty and the condition holds vacuously, as in the informal statement. Faithful.
